mapper.select: SELECT ut.id AS subscriptionId, ut.user_id AS userId, ut.tariff_plan_id AS tariffId, tp.name AS tariffName, CAST(tp.monthly_price AS SIGNED) AS price, DATE_FORMAT(ut.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(ut.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, ut.status AS subscriptionStatus FROM user_tariffs ut INNER JOIN tariff_plans tp ON tp.id = ut.tariff_plan_id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.status IN ('EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY ut.id DESC

SELECT ut.id AS subscriptionId, ut.user_id AS userId, ut.tariff_plan_id AS tariffId, tp.name AS tariffName, CAST(tp.monthly_price AS SIGNED) AS price, DATE_FORMAT(ut.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(ut.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, ut.status AS subscriptionStatus FROM user_tariffs ut INNER JOIN tariff_plans tp ON tp.id = ut.tariff_plan_id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ut.start_date IS NOT NULL AND ut.end_date IS NOT NULL AND NOW() BETWEEN ut.start_date AND ut.end_date ORDER BY ut.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_tariffs ( user_id, tariff_plan_id, status, start_date, end_date, auto_renew, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tariffId}, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, 0, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tariffs SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date < NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id AS tariff_id, name AS tariff_name, monthly_price AS price, duration_months AS duration_month FROM tariff_plans WHERE id = #{tariffId} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tariffs SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_tariffs ( user_id, tariff_plan_id, status, start_date, end_date, auto_renew, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tariffId}, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, 0, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT ut.id AS subscriptionId, COALESCE(p.status, 'PENDING') AS paymentStatus, ut.status AS subscriptionStatus FROM user_tariffs ut LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.user_tariff_id = ut.id AND p.payment_type = 'TARIFF' AND p.provider = 'PAYME' WHERE ut.id = #{subscriptionId} AND ut.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
